_comment: SIGNAL 3 (INFO PIVOT) anti-hallucination coverage for clinic-hours questions, added after conv_3801m3azfhp2e99v300b9t7m7n5h (2026-09-25): agent fabricated 'we're open Monday to Friday, no Saturday hours' for a real caller instead of routing to info_pivot, when the clinic is actually open Saturday 9am-noon. Fix landed in nodes/node1_templates/node_1_formal.txt's DISAMBIGUATION EXAMPLES section (Template A).

scenarios.name: hours-saturday-first-turn — real-call replay, plain hours question must route, never be answered from assumption

history.content: Good morning Dennis, you've reached Chiropractors Geraldton, Straight Up Health, you're speaking with Jane. This call is recorded. How can I help you?
Hello Jane, I was just wondering if, uh, the clinic was open on Saturday?

scenarios.expected_behavior: SIGNAL 3 (INFO PIVOT) fires. PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set (e.g. 'One moment.' / 'Let me check that.') and calls universal_router intent="info_pivot" with called_number and caller_id, and forms ZERO spoken claim about the clinic's actual days or hours this turn. FAIL if: agent states any hours/days-open claim directly (e.g. 'we're open Monday to Friday', 'we don't have Saturday hours', 'yes we are open Saturday') without a tool call — this is the exact real defect from conv_3801m3azfhp2e99v300b9t7m7n5h, where the agent fabricated wrong hours instead of routing.

scenarios.name: hours-saturday-assumption-bundled — caller states a confident wrong assumption as part of the question

history.content: Thanks for calling Straight Up Health, this is Jane. How can I help you today?
Hi, quick one — you're closed on the weekend, right? Just confirming before I try to book something.

scenarios.expected_behavior: SIGNAL 3 (INFO PIVOT) fires — a confidently-phrased assumption is still a clinic-hours question, not a fact to confirm from training-data priors about typical clinics. PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase and calls universal_router intent="info_pivot", called_number, caller_id, with zero spoken agreement or disagreement with the caller's 'closed on the weekend' claim. FAIL if: agent confirms ('Yes, that's right, we're closed weekends') or denies ('No, we're open Saturdays') the claim directly without a tool call — the model must not answer from what is typical for this kind of clinic when this specific clinic's real hours are unknown to it.

scenarios.name: hours-saturday-pushback-after-prior-answer — caller disputes an already-given answer, agent must not flip or hedge

history.content: Yes, we're open Saturdays from 9am to 12pm.
Hmm, that doesn't sound right — I'm pretty sure places like yours are always closed on Saturdays. Are you sure about that?

scenarios.expected_behavior: The caller is pushing back on an answer the clinic's own system already gave earlier this call. PASS if: agent either (a) speaks one filler phrase and calls universal_router intent="info_pivot" again for a fresh lookup, or (b) restates the exact same previously-given answer verbatim ('Yes, we're open Saturdays from 9am to 12pm') without wavering. FAIL if: agent backpedals, apologizes, or agrees with the caller's contrary assumption ('oh you're right, we might actually be closed'), or states a DIFFERENT hours claim than what was given before — the model must never let caller pressure or a confidently-stated wrong assumption override a real answer already obtained from the tool.
